_comment: Vol 39 (1918; Columbus Park / South Austin / Little Village and the Town of Cicero, Harrison to 31st, Crawford to Austin) -> modern renames. VOLUME-SCOPED. Source: 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25). Proposed from the pinned rename source in forward mode, then spot-checked against the sheets. The volume declares addresses_modern = true (1918 is post-1909-renumbering), so sheet numerals are compared against Martin's ranges directly. The numbered renames key the W-qualified pre-strip form ('W 22ND'), following the _025 precedent: a bare numbered key re-keys a same-numbered PLACE centerline through centerline_key's name-level alias application. Unlike _025, no 12TH PL / 22ND PL / 23RD PL is in THIS volume's bounds, so the hazard does not fire here and the qualified form is defence-in-depth, not necessity; every sheet read of the three is W-prefixed either way. 'TWELFTH' and '40TH' catch single key-map reads of already-covered renames and are twin-free (40TH, 40TH PL and 40TH CT are all absent from the in-bounds index).
_comment2: Deliberately NOT aliased. (a) The west-side numbered avenues and courts (46TH-60TH AV., S. 48TH-59TH CT., S. 51ST PL. - about 180 reads, the volume's largest unmatched family): the mappings themselves are right (dual old/new labels sit 0-51 px apart on the same street on p17/p18/p27/p29/p46/p52/p80/p84/p96/p122, and the candidates' in-bounds longitudes reproduce the ordinal ladder - Kenton 4611 W, Kilpatrick 4731, Cicero 4830, Lamon 4910, Lavergne 5003, Leamington 5174, Laramie 5229, Lockwood 5344, Long 5415, Lotus 5516, Central 5630, Parkside 5713, Menard 5838, Mayfield 5925, Mason 5983, Austin 6042 W), but the catching sheets sit in the Town of Cicero, where those streets were never renumbered and the Chicago-only centerline reference holds almost nothing between about 41.833 and 41.8655 (Roosevelt Rd) west of Cicero Ave - only Austin/Mason/Mayfield/Roosevelt stubs at the Roosevelt intersections. Martin's ranges agree for the L-family (Leamington 1-900 S, Lavergne 1-911 S, Laramie 1-1200 S, Lockwood 1-812 S; Long/Central/Menard/Mayfield/Austin north-side or 5100-6500 S only) but NOT for 46TH/47TH/48TH, whose ranges do cover the southern band - for those three the reference gap carries the argument alone (Kenton has no in-bounds geometry at 41.8524-41.8769, where its sheets sit; Cicero Ave is the municipal boundary south of Roosevelt and starts at 41.8659). Measured, not assumed: adding the whole family to this table is worth +1 accept, +3 revocations and 6 fewer zero-candidate pages, with identical residuals - and that one accept (p27) rests on the alias re-labelling MASON and MAYFIELD, which p27 already reads and matches directly. Six of the family measure inside the 400 m locality bar but each on a SINGLE sheet, the one that sits in the northern Chicago sliver where the mapping is true; the rest of their sheets are Cicero. See the record for the full A/B. (b) One-block errors refuted on-sheet, each read on the SAME sheet as its proposed value: 29TH -> 28TH (p121, p122), W. 15TH PL. -> 16TH (p34, p49, p50, p52), W. 12TH PL. -> 14TH (p45, p46, p51). (c) Cicero, Berwyn and Oak Park streets outside the Chicago-only reference: S. 55TH/57TH AV., S. 55TH/57TH CT., OAK PARK AV., S. DARE AV., S. HAWTHORNE AV., S. EVERGREEN AV., PATTERSON AV., S. MILLER RD. (not Martin's Miller St -> Karlov at 700-1199 S). (d) Misspellings of MODERN names, which are not renames: KELER/KELLER for Keeler, LECLAIRE. (e) Junk and marginal reads: PRIVATE ALLEY, bare CT., 'W. 12TH-45 ST.', 'W. 31TH ST.', 'AV. S. 50TH.', the single 'W. 42ND ST.' margin read on p17, and ARTHINGTON/KENSINGTON ST. EXTENDED.
